summary: The customer called to complain about a delayed mobile phone order that was supposed to arrive three days ago. The agent investigated, identified a courier sorting facility delay, and informed the customer that the package is out for delivery today and will arrive by 4:00 PM. The customer was satisfied and the issue was resolved.

evidence.text: Thank you for calling Swift Communications, my name is Marcus. How can I help you today?
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent maintained a polite, professional, and courteous tone throughout the entire call.

evidence.text: I completely understand your frustration, and I apologize for the delay with your shipment.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent acknowledged the customer's frustration and offered a sincere apology for the delay right away.

evidence.text: Yes, the courier's real-time status confirms it will be delivered by 4:00 PM this afternoon.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent successfully tracked the order, explained the cause of the delay, and provided a definitive delivery time.

evidence.text: Ah, I see the courier experienced a sorting facility delay in your area, which held it up over the weekend.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent explained the tracking details clearly and concisely without confusing jargon.

evidence.text: Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent offered further assistance, thanked the customer, and delivered a warm, complete closing.

evidence.text: it looks like it was just loaded onto the local delivery truck this morning and is out for delivery today.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The information provided matched the system tracking details and was accurate.

evidence.text: May I have your account number or order reference, please?
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent properly verified the customer by asking for the order reference before looking up account details.

quote.text: It's still not here, and I need it for work!
quote.speaker: Customer

quote.text: Oh, really? So it's actually coming today?
quote.speaker: Customer

quote.text: Well, that's a relief. I was worried it got lost in transit. Thanks for checking that so quickly, Marcus.
quote.speaker: Customer

quote.text: No, that covers it. Have a good day.
quote.speaker: Customer
